source_identity.canonical_title: Le "wokisme" n'existe que dans les discours anti-progressistes : c'est un homme de paille créé artificiellement pour faire semblant d'avoir un adversaire oppresseur

translation.canonical_title: "Wokeism" exists only in anti-progressive discourse: it is a straw man artificially created to pretend that one has an oppressive adversary
translation.displayed_title: "Wokeism" exists only in anti-progressive discourse; it is a straw man artificially created to pretend that one has an oppressive adversary
translation.summary: No one describes themselves as “woke.” This word, this neologism, is used to create a progressive yet authoritarian and intolerant figure in order to criticize progressive ideas openly. The word is therefore used only by the political opponents of these ideas and is not claimed at all by any existing groups.

source_parameters.name: citation
source_parameters.value: "Pour le politologue [[frwikipedia:Clément_Viktorovitch|Clément Viktorovitch]], le terme « woke » est aujourd'hui davantage utilisé par les adversaires aux mouvements progressistes que par les militants eux-mêmes. D'après lui, ce mot est devenu un concept fourre-tout, « un outil purement rhétorique, une arme de disqualification massive utilisée contre le discours de gauche ». Il constate que les polémiques autour du ''wokisme'' ont progressivement remplacé celles autour de l'[[frwikipedia:Islamo-gauchisme|islamo-gauchisme]] mais qu'elles ont les mêmes finalités : « disqualifier les luttes antiracistes et féministes ». "

citations.translated_citation: “According to political scientist [[enwikipedia:Clément_Viktorovitch|Clément Viktorovitch]], the term ‘woke’ is now used more by opponents of progressive movements than by activists themselves. In his view, the word has become a catch-all concept, ‘a purely rhetorical tool, a weapon of mass disqualification used against left-wing discourse.’ He observes that controversies surrounding ''wokeism'' have gradually replaced those surrounding [[enwikipedia:Islamo-leftism|Islamo-leftism]], but that they serve the same purposes: ‘disqualifying antiracist and feminist struggles.’”
